# Stanford Online

> > Stanford Online provides university-level courses, credentials, and degree programs from Stanford University's schools including Engineering, Medicine, Business, and Sustainability, with digital badges and blockchain-verified certificates.

Stanford Online offers online learning opportunities across multiple disciplines, featuring courses in clinical research, business, engineering, humanities, and sustainability. The platform provides credential programs with digital badges and blockchain verification, operating on a quarter system with structured academic calendars.

## Key Topics

- Stanford University
- Stanford Doerr School of Sustainability
- Graduate School of Business
- Graduate School of Education
- School of Engineering
- School of Medicine
- Digital badges and blockchain verification
- Certificate programs
- Clinical trials and medical research
- PICOT framework
- Quarter system
- Academic calendar and enrollment dates
- Continuing education
- Research methodology

## Credentials and Programs

- [Stanford Credentials](https://online.stanford.edu/stanford-credentials): Stanford credential programs with digital badges and blockchain verification

## Courses

- [Clinical Trials: Design, Strategy, and Analysis](https://online.stanford.edu/courses/som-xche0030-clinical-trials-design-strategy-and-analysis): Course on clinical trial design, data analysis using PICOT framework

## Academic Calendar and Key Dates

- [Academic Calendar 2025-2026 - Incomplete Deadline](https://online.stanford.edu/calendar/202412/incomplete-deadline): 2025-2026 academic calendar with incomplete deadline for December 2024
- [Academic Calendar 2025-2026 - Grades Due](https://online.stanford.edu/calendar/202403/grades-due): 2025-2026 academic calendar with grades due date for March 2024
- [Academic Calendar 2025-2026 - Grading Basis Change](https://online.stanford.edu/calendar/202411/change-grading-basis): 2025-2026 academic calendar with grading basis change deadline Nov 2024
